crossRefs.note: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony in its own times,
And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children…

translations.web: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’
translations.bsb: ‘Sir,’ the servant replied, ‘what you ordered has been done, and there is still room.’
translations.kjv: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
translations.asv: And the servant said, Lord, what thou didst command is done, and yet there is room.
